caption: The drawing depicts two stylized rooster-shaped objects, both attached to vertical wooden stakes or rods. The larger rooster is positioned in the upper right quadrant of the page and features a predominantly greenish-brown body with subtle shading and brushstrokes accentuating the contours. It has a rounded body, a large, fanned tail with darker stripes, a comb on top of its head painted in a grayish-green hue, a yellow beak, and a small red wattle beneath the beak. The eye is round and white with a black pupil. The stake extending downward from the underside of the body is painted in muted brown tones with sketchy detailing. The smaller rooster is located in the lower left quadrant, mirroring the design of the larger figure but in a more compact form. Its body is a mix of brown, red, and black-grey tones, it has a yellow beak, a red wattle, and a dark eye. Like the larger figure, it is also attached to a stake painted in a similar color. The background of the drawing is a plain, unadorned, slightly yellowed parchment or paper with minor spots and marks.
title: Counterbalance Rooster
